headline: Singapore Upgrades 2026 Non-Oil Domestic Export Growth Forecast to 30%-32%
summary: Enterprise Singapore raised its 2026 key export growth forecast to between 30% and 32%, up from an earlier projection of 14% to 16%, though trade growth is expected to moderate in 2027.
why: Singapore's export statistics serve as a leading barometer for global trade health and semiconductor demand across Asia.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Upgraded export expectations reflect stronger international demand for electronic and non-oil goods.
